confirmed_findings.claim: A working-copy edit of acdsl/policy.json setting mode free plus an unresolvable base_ref makes policyBase fail before the authoritative base policy is read, so CheckPolicy returns nil,nil and fully bypasses gated/strict enforcement.
confirmed_findings.fix: When policy.BaseRef fails to resolve, fall back to the default candidate chain (origin/HEAD, origin/main, main, master) instead of only the override; and/or never let the baseErr fallback consult the working copy's Mode — an unresolvable base with any acdsl/policy.json on disk should hard-error, matching D10's 'never a silent pass'.

confirmed_findings.claim: The commit registering acdsl-policy-guard.sh also deleted the four pre-existing permissions.ask entries for Edit/Write on acdsl/** and **/*.acdsl with no plan-recorded decision, leaving smine's own free-mode repo with zero confirmation prompt on edits to its rule and verifier definitions.
confirmed_findings.fix: Restore the ask entries for smine's own settings (defense-in-depth even in free mode, since the hook/binary gate only fire in strict/gated), or make the removal an explicit, plan-recorded decision if intentional.

confirmed_findings.claim: The unanchored prefix match "/$required"* lets any skill whose name is a prefix-extension of the required one (e.g. /smine-batch for required smine) silently satisfy the gate.
confirmed_findings.fix: Require a word boundary after the required name — match only "/$required" exact or "/$required" followed by whitespace or newline, never a bare prefix.

confirmed_findings.claim: On a cache-miss fresh scan that errors, entry keeps the previous stale cache value and data.ScannedAt is set unconditionally, so the fragment shows the error banner alongside a stale 'as of HH:MM:SS' timestamp from a scan that never ran for this render.
confirmed_findings.fix: Only set data.ScannedAt when data.Cached is true or err == nil; leave it zero otherwise (the template already handles .ScannedAt.IsZero).

confirmed_findings.claim: GitShowFile's 'absent path means ok=false, never an error' contract implicitly depends on the underlying git failure being an *exec.ExitError from the current shell.Run implementation.
confirmed_findings.fix: Add a one-line comment at the call site noting the coupling in case shell.Run's error wrapping ever changes.

confirmed_findings.claim: The Bash-command target extraction only catches the single-word 'cat file' shape, so head, sed -n, less, or a quoted cat "$file" all bypass the post-invocation context-read deterrent.

overlayViolations and the Registry/Policy struct field orderings mirror the approved plan verbatim, including field groupings that don't sort alphabetically within their group per RULE-GOLANG-STRUCT-002 — a deviation introduced by the plan itself.
